# bincraft

{bincraft} provides the ability to build R package binaries for Linux.
It is the core engine of the [rpkgs.com](https://rpkgs.com) project.

## Highlights ✨️

- Auto-resolve package and system dependencies during installation
- Archive multiple versions of a package into a CRAN-like archive
  structure
- Support storing packages in S3 instead of on disk
- Process CRAN repository updates
- Support building binaries for Ubuntu, RHEL and Alpine Linux
- Allows building packages for specific R minor versions
  (`is_r_minor_sensitive = TRUE`)
- ABI-risk classifier ([design
  doc](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/tools/abi-classifier.md)) tells
  the build pipeline whether a package needs per-R-minor recompiles,
  building-once-then-replicating, or no compile at all
- Creation of custom/personal repositories

Besides building binaries, the package optionally allows to store the
build metadata (duration, version, name, errors, etc.) in a (Postgres)
database.

> \[!NOTE\] The package functions must be run within the desired
> distribution for which binaries should be built for. See
> [rpkgs/build-cran-binaries/docker](https://codefloe.com/rpkgs/build-cran-binaries/src/branch/main/docker)
> for containerfiles which have been built for this purpose.

See the [pkgdown documentation](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com) for more
details.

# Package index

## Main Workflow Functions

High-level functions for the main binary building workflow

- [`process_cran_updates()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/process_cran_updates.md)
  : Process updated and new CRAN packages
- [`build_binary_package()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/build_binary_package.md)
  : Build R binary packages

## CRAN Package Discovery

Functions to discover package changes from CRAN

- [`get_new_cran_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_new_cran_packages.md)
  : Get new CRAN packages
- [`get_updated_cran_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_updated_cran_packages.md)
  : Get updated CRAN packages
- [`get_removed_cran_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_removed_cran_packages.md)
  : Get removed CRAN packages
- [`get_r_minor_sensitive_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_r_minor_sensitive_packages.md)
  : Returns R minor sensitive R packages

## ABI Classification

Classify packages by ABI-risk tier to decide per-minor rebuild strategy

- [`abi_classify()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/abi_classify.md)
  : Classify an R source package by its ABI-risk tier
- [`classify_r_minor_sensitive()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/classify_r_minor_sensitive.md)
  : Classify a single CRAN package for R-minor sensitivity
- [`needs_per_minor_recompile()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/needs_per_minor_recompile.md)
  : Does this package need to be recompiled per R minor version?
- [`abi_volatile_symbols()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/abi_curated_lists.md)
  [`abi_risky_linking_deps()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/abi_curated_lists.md)
  : ABI-risky curated lists

## Archive Management

Functions for archiving old package versions

- [`archive_package()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/archive_package.md)
  : Archive packages in CRAN-like repositories
- [`process_unarchived_pkgs()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/process_unarchived_pkgs.md)
  : Returns packages that need to be archived (have multiple versions)
- [`write_archive_rds()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/write_archive_rds.md)
  : Create Meta/archive.rds for {remotes} package

## Upload & Storage

Functions for uploading packages and managing S3 storage

- [`upload_single_binary()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/upload_single_binary.md)
  : Upload binary to S3
- [`upload_source_tarball()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/upload_source_tarball.md)
  : Uploads source tarballs to S3
- [`upload_package_index()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/upload_package_index.md)
  : Upload package index files to S3

## Repository Index Management

Functions for creating and managing CRAN-like repository indices

- [`add_to_package_index()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/add_to_package_index.md)
  : Add package to repository index

## Metadata & Database

Functions for managing build metadata and database operations

- [`list_metadata_tables()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/list_metadata_tables.md)
  : List existing database tables
- [`query_metadata_table()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/query_metadata_table.md)
  : Query a specific table in the Postgres database containing the
  metadata
- [`query_packages_without_historic_versions()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/query_packages_without_historic_versions.md)
  : Returns packages that do not have any historic versions stored in S3
- [`get_missing_pkgs_db()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_missing_pkgs_db.md)
  : Returns all packages names of CRAN packages not present in the
  linked database

## Utilities & Helpers

Utility functions for configuration and checks

- [`check_for_binary()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/check_for_binary.md)
  : Checks whether a binary for the latest package version exists
- [`set_bin_path()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/set_bin_path.md)
  : Set path for binary package outputs
- [`set_codename()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/set_codename.md)
  : Set codename for Linux distribution
- [`init_repo()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/init_repo.md)
  : Initialize a new R repository
- [`build_single_tag()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/build_single_tag.md)
  : Build binary for a single tag
- [`install_pkg_sys_deps()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/install_pkg_sys_deps.md)
  : Install R dependencies and their system requirements for a package

## Internal Helper Functions

Internal helper functions used by the main workflow (typically not
called directly)

- [`archive_single_package()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/archive_single_package.md)
  : Archive a single package
- [`artifact_version()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/artifact_version.md)
  : Version used in artifact names for a git tag
- [`check_build_skip_conditions()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/check_build_skip_conditions.md)
  : Check if build should be skipped
- [`check_package_error()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/check_package_error.md)
  : Check if a package has previous build errors
- [`check_s3_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/check_s3_packages.md)
  : Check S3 for existing packages
- [`check_s3_root_package()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/check_s3_root_package.md)
  : Check if root package exists in S3 for check_s3_packages
- [`clean_duplicated_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/clean_duplicated_packages.md)
  : Clean duplicated package files
- [`clone_package_repo()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/clone_package_repo.md)
  : Clone package repository
- [`clone_repository()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/clone_repository.md)
  : Clone package repository
- [`determine_packages_to_build()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/determine_packages_to_build.md)
  : Determine which packages need to be built
- [`execute_package_build()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/execute_package_build.md)
  : Execute the actual package build
- [`execute_package_builds()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/execute_package_builds.md)
  : Execute package builds with parallel processing
- [`filter_packages_with_errors()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/filter_packages_with_errors.md)
  : Filter packages with previous build errors
- [`filter_tags()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/filter_tags.md)
  : Filter git tags for package versions
- [`find_old_versions()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/find_old_versions.md)
  : Find old package versions to archive
- [`get_all_s3_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_all_s3_packages.md)
  : Get all packages from S3 for comparison
- [`get_archive_path()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_archive_path.md)
  : Get archive destination path
- [`get_minor_version()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_minor_version.md)
  : Get R minor version string
- [`get_remote_search_path()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_remote_search_path.md)
  : Archive helper functions for package archiving operations Get remote
  search path for package archives
- [`get_system_architecture_info()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/get_system_architecture_info.md)
  : Get system architecture information
- [`handle_build_output_files()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/handle_build_output_files.md)
  : Handle build output files and cleanup
- [`handle_post_build_actions()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/handle_post_build_actions.md)
  : Handle post-build actions
- [`handle_system_dependencies()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/handle_system_dependencies.md)
  : Handle system dependency installation
- [`initialize_build_environment()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/initialize_build_environment.md)
  : Initialize build environment and setup paths
- [`list_archived_packages()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/list_archived_packages.md)
  : Check if root package exists in S3
- [`move_and_rename_tarball()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/move_and_rename_tarball.md)
  : Move and rename built tarball files
- [`parse_package_tag_pairs()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/parse_package_tag_pairs.md)
  : Build helper functions for package building operations Parse package
  tag pairs from difference strings
- [`process_tag_filtering()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/process_tag_filtering.md)
  : Process tag filtering for check_s3_packages
- [`remove_from_metadata()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/remove_from_metadata.md)
  : Remove package from metadata table
- [`retry_with_backoff()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/retry_with_backoff.md)
  : Retry a function with exponential backoff
- [`stamp_description_version()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/stamp_description_version.md)
  : Stamp a version into a cloned DESCRIPTION
- [`store_build_metadata()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/store_build_metadata.md)
  : Store build metadata of single binary builds
- [`tag_version()`](https://bincraft.doc.rpkgs.com/reference/tag_version.md)
  : Package version named by a git tag
